related.title: Xanadu Aurora：GKP 編碼的位移尺度
related.titleEn: Xanadu Aurora: displacement scales in GKP encoding
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：報告擦除位置正確率與邏輯失敗率兩項，不從39.6的期望值推斷某個碼一定容錯。 另一位學徒須能從輸入與算式重算，而非僅讀結論。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Report loss-location accuracy and logical failure separately;39.6 expected erasures does not establish a code threshold. A second learner must be able to reconstruct the result from inputs and equations.
related.difference: 用簡化高斯位移模型理解編碼格點邊界，避免把小雜訊等同零邏輯錯誤。
related.differenceEn: Use a simplified Gaussian displacement model to understand lattice boundaries without equating small noise with zero logical error.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 以下情境參數為合成教學輸入，並非案例設備實測或廠商規格；光速、波茲曼常數等標準物理常數另依名稱與單位標明。每光子保留率0.95，1000個雙光子介面。 期望擦除介面=N(1−η²)。 代入 1000*(1-0.95**2)，得到 97.5 interfaces。獨立雙光子介面至少一個遺失的機率1−η²；遺失位置可觀測不代表能全部修復。 將式子拆成至少兩個中間欄，逐欄保留單位。

以下情境參數為合成教學輸入，並非案例設備實測或廠商規格；光速、波茲曼常數等標準物理常數另依名稱與單位標明。高斯位移標準差σ=0.2，忽略有限包絡、相關雜訊與偵測誤差。 z=(sqrtπ/2)/σ。 代入 sqrt(pi)/(2*0.2)，得到 4.43113 sigma units。採用無因次正交量，格距sqrtπ；最近格點的半距sqrtπ/2，餘裕比是半距/σ。此比值不是錯誤率。 將式子拆成至少兩個中間欄，逐欄保留單位。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Scenario parameters below are synthetic teaching inputs, not measurements or specifications of the named device; standard physical constants such as the speed of light and Boltzmann constant are identified separately by name and unit. Per-photon survival0.95 across1000 two-photon interfaces. Expected erased interfaces=N(1−η²). Substituting 1000*(1-0.95**2) gives 97.5 interfaces. A two-photon interface loses at least one photon with probability1−η²; locating loss does not guarantee correction. Split the expression into at least two intermediate columns and retain their units.

Scenario parameters below are synthetic teaching inputs, not measurements or specifications of the named device; standard physical constants such as the speed of light and Boltzmann constant are identified separately by name and unit. Gaussian displacementσ=0.2, neglecting finite envelopes, correlations and measurement error. z=(sqrtπ/2)/σ. Substituting sqrt(pi)/(2*0.2) gives 4.43113 sigma units. Use dimensionless quadratures with spacingsqrtπ; half-spacing is sqrtπ/2 and margin ratio is half-spacing/σ, not an error probability. Split the expression into at least two intermediate columns and retain their units.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
